summary: Iteration 133: StockFit Fundamentals Feature Testing - 19/19 BACKEND TESTS PASSED, FRONTEND FULLY FUNCTIONAL. All StockFit SEC EDGAR data endpoints verified working correctly. Frontend displays F-Score, EPS, Revenue Growth, margins, income statement, and balance sheet correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Console warnings about duplicate React keys (bid-1.46, bid-0.26) - not critical but should be fixed for cleaner logs
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 133 tested the NEW StockFit Fundamentals feature. Backend endpoints verified: (1) GET /api/stockfit/fundamentals/{symbol} - returns aggregated income, balance sheet, scores, earnings data, (2) GET /api/stockfit/income/{symbol} - income statement array, (3) GET /api/stockfit/balance-sheet/{symbol} - balance sheet array, (4) GET /api/stockfit/scores/{symbol} - Piotroski F-Score and Altman Z-Score, (5) GET /api/stockfit/earnings/{symbol} - earnings snapshot with EPS. Public API endpoint GET /api/v1/fundamentals/{symbol} requires Pro tier API key. Frontend verified: StockFit tab visible in Research Hub, AAPL quick button loads data correctly, F-Score 8/9 displayed, EPS $7.49, Revenue Growth 6.4%, Operating Margin 32.0% (NOT 3197%), Net Margin 26.9% (NOT 2692%), Piotroski Checklist shows individual criteria, Income Statement table shows 3 years of data, Balance Sheet section visible. Margin values are correctly using pctRaw() function (not multiplied by 100).
